description: Defines classes for PDF stream filtering, including FilterParms and an abstract Filter class with encoding/decoding methods.

classes.name: FilterParms
classes.description: Holds decoding parameters for a PDF filter, may be null.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Abstract base class for all PDF stream filters, providing encoding and decoding methods.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Abstract method to encode data; implemented in derived classes.

methods.name: Encode (string rawString)
methods.description: Encodes a raw string into bytes using the specified encoding and then applies the filter.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Abstract method to decode data; implemented in derived classes.

methods.name: Decode (byte[] data, PdfDictionary? decodeParms)
methods.description: Decodes data using provided filter parameters.

methods.name: DecodeToString
methods.description: Decodes data to a string using specified filter parameters.

methods.name: DecodeToString (byte[] data)
methods.description: Decodes data to a string with default parameters.

methods.name: RemoveWhiteSpace
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from byte array, assuming bytes are characters.
